text:
Predicates:
BakedSweets(x) ::: x are baked sweets.
Spicy(x) ::: x is spicy.
Cupcake(x) ::: x are cupcakes.
MalaHotpot(x) ::: x are mala hotpots.
FromBakedByMelissa(x) ::: x are products from Baked by Melissa.
DriedThaiChilies ::: dried Thai chilies.
Premises:
¬∃x (BakedSweets(x) ∧ Spicy(x)) ::: No baked sweets are spicy.
∀x (Cupcake(x) → BakedSweets(x)) ::: All cupcakes are baked sweets.
∀x (MalaHotpot(x) → Spicy(x)) ::: All mala hotpots are spicy.
∀x (FromBakedByMelissa(x) → Cupcake(x)) ::: All products from Baked by Melissa are cupcakes.
Spicy(DriedThaiChilies) ∨ MalaHotpot(DriedThaiChilies) ∨ ¬BakedSweets(DriedThaiChilies) ::: Dried Thai chilies are spicy or mala hotpots or not baked sweets.
Conclusion:
Uncertain ::: Dried Thai chilies are products of Baked by Melissa.
